laws.rule: Great Zimbabwe site museum/campsite: the heritage authority encourages visitors to refrain from feeding monkeys and baboons. This published recommendation is not turned into a statutory offence. The page identifies an official campsite near the main entrance; it does not permit camping throughout the monument.
